name: example-afdx
description: ARINC 664 bench, filled in on the development PC (RUN-AFDX2): one port, no peer — receive 20 s, then send VL 20 for 20 s on the same port and capture it back (loopback). On a bench: put the ports of network A and B, list the VLs NexysNet should send in txVls, set expectPeer to true.
notes: Port names come from the log line 'ports:' of a first run (the packet-capture library's description, or a part of the device id). The development PC's only connected adapter is Wi-Fi: its driver refuses raw frames, so N2 shows the send errors and the loopback inside the library, not a transmission.
